_comment: Recorded perf baselines (PERF §5). Each entry: the pinned number, the release that measured it, and what regression looks like. Ratio tests multiply by --perf-tolerance (default 1.25).

conftest_snapshot.note: T-9: conftest._BASELINE_MODS snapshot size. Growth past the budget means the per-test _restore() cost is drifting up (measured 0.43 ms/test at 57 modules) — trim module state or split a module before adding more.

active_tools_floor.note: The non-gated schema count sent every turn. A new always-on tool must displace one into tier-2 or justify the rise in the test_initial_context ledger (feature-cost rule, PERF §6).
